The correct answer is **$10,000** (costs incurred only), because the homeowner’s wrongful stop and the builder’s claim here rest on unjust enrichment, limiting recovery to the benefit conferred rather than full expectation damages. The $3,000 increase in property value does not cap recovery when the builder’s incurred costs were greater, so he recovers the $9,000 framing cost plus $1,000 for materials, net of the $1,000 resale offset.  
CONFIDENCE: 88
